# AdaptiveFrequencyResonateFire

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A neuron model that adjusts its resonant frequency dynamically to match input spectral features, enabling efficient spike-based encoding of frequency-specific signals. This enables neuromorphic systems to perform spectral analysis in real time with low energy, critical for in-network signal processing and edge AI.
